summary_en: 3,900,000 shares (16.2% of S/O), ¥1,415.7M limit, ToSTNeT-3 order at ¥363/share (2026-08-05 market close), executed 2026-08-05 08:45 JST. KDDI (principal shareholder) confirmed willingness to participate. Results published post-execution same day.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-04, Gunosy's board resolved to acquire up to 3,900,000 treasury shares (16.2% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥1.42 billion via a single ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block trade on 2026-08-05 at 08:45 JST. The order price is ¥363/share, being the closing price of 2026-08-04. The order is for a single trading session window and will be executed as a block matching supplied sell orders; execution is not guaranteed and market conditions may result in partial or no execution. Results will be published immediately after the 08:45 trading session. The company confirmed that principal shareholder KDDI has expressed willingness to participate in the trade. This program is intended to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital allocation responsive to changing business conditions.
